title: Visual HUD
description: A clean, fully customizable client-side HUD overlay for Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric — shows coordinates, FPS, biome, time, direction, light level, speed, day count, dimension, compass, and FPS sparkline with an in-game config screen.
body:
# Visual HUD

A clean, fully customizable HUD overlay for Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric. Client-side only — no server-side install needed.

## Features

- **Coordinates** — XYZ position with green highlighting
- **FPS Counter** — with color-coded bar sparkline graph
- **Biome** — current biome name (nicely formatted)
- **Time** — 12-hour clock with AM/PM and day/night icon
- **Direction** — compass direction with full name
- **Light Level** — block/sky light levels
- **Speed** — real-time movement speed in m/s
- **Day Counter** — current in-game day
- **Dimension** — shows Overworld / Nether / The End
- **Compass Strip** — interactive compass bar showing all 8 directions
- **FPS Sparkline** — real-time bar graph of recent FPS history

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| **H** | Toggle HUD visibility (animated) |
| **C** | Open configuration screen |
| **ALT + Left Click** | Drag to reposition anywhere on screen |

All controls are rebindable in Minecraft's Controls settings.

## Configuration

Press **C** in-game to open the config screen where you can:
- Toggle each HUD element on/off individually
- Toggle all elements at once
- Pick from 10 accent colors
- Reset HUD position to default

The HUD fades in/out smoothly when toggled and remembers your settings in `config/visualhud.json`.

## Visual

- Semi-transparent dark panel with accent color strip
- Color-coded text for readability at a glance
- Text shadows for visibility on any background
- Smooth fade animation on toggle
- Draggable anywhere on screen
- Resets on game restart — no persistence unless you save via config

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **>=0.18.2**
- Fabric API
- Java **>=21**

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11
2. Download Fabric API and place in `.minecraft/mods`
3. Download Visual HUD and place in `.minecraft/mods`
4. Launch and press **H** to toggle the HUD, **C** to configure
